headline: QA-focused signals: agent governance, AI-assisted PR scanning, Apple runner updates, static analysis, and resilience testing

top_signal.title: Enterprise-managed permissions for GitHub Copilot agent operations (generally available)
top_signal.summary: GitHub now lets Copilot Business and Enterprise admins centrally block, require approval, or allow specific agent operations (shell commands, file reads/edits, network domains) to enforce fine-grained guardrails across teams.
top_signal.why_it_matters: Provides QA leaders control over agentic testing workflows — enable automated test agents while preventing unsafe operations and ensuring reproducible, auditable agent behavior.

items.title: AI Scan for pull request APIs enter public preview (GitHub code scanning)
items.summary: GitHub released REST APIs in public preview to programmatically enable or disable AI Scan for pull requests at org and repo levels, letting teams roll out AI-powered PR security detections at scale.
items.why_it_matters: QA teams can automate enrollment and governance for AI-based PR scans, integrating AI detections into test gates and audit logs across many repositories.

items.title: Xcode 27 runner image now runs on macOS 27 (public preview)
items.summary: GitHub-hosted macOS runner image for Xcode 27 now runs on macOS 27 (arm64) in public preview; workflows continue to target labels like `xcode-27` and `xcode-27-xlarge`.
items.why_it_matters: iOS/macOS app teams and QA can validate builds/tests against macOS 27 earlier — update device matrices, simulator test targets, and runner expectations to avoid compatibility drift.

items.title: CodeQL 2.27.0 adds Linux ARM64 support and new language coverage
items.summary: CodeQL 2.27.0 is available for Linux ARM64, adds Rust security queries, improves Java/Kotlin and C# framework modelling, and increases analysis accuracy across languages.
items.why_it_matters: Static analysis in CI and pre-merge scanning gains broader platform parity and new queries (Rust), improving early detection and test-orchestration accuracy for ARM-based builds.

watch.title: AI x QA Leadership Summit 2026 — BrowserStack (virtual, Sept 23)
watch.summary: BrowserStack’s QA Leadership Summit (Sept 23, 2026) runs two tracks: AI strategy/governance for QA leaders and hands-on applied AI testing workshops for practitioners.
watch.why_it_matters: Useful forum to compare AI-native QA governance patterns, agent controls, and practical demos that influence QA roadmaps and automation policies.

learning.title: Testing application resilience with Amazon SQS and AWS Fault Injection Service (how-to)
learning.summary: AWS provides a step-by-step resilience experiment that uses AWS FIS and SSM Automation to progressively deny SQS data-plane operations, observe recovery, and validate retry/circuit-breaker behavior and observability metrics.
learning.why_it_matters: Practical guide for QA leads to design measurable chaos tests for message-driven systems, verify failure-handling and observability, and produce testable hypotheses for resilience SLAs.
